messages:
nina: Heads-up: noticed a pattern where per-route quota ceilings + continuous batching cause small token rounding to push some tenants over invoice thresholds. Need a small mitigation plan before next deployment.

jorge: Can you show an example? is this from the aggregator or during finalization?

nina: Aggregator emits fractional token counts post-batch (floats). Finalizer currently ceil()s per-route totals before summing which amplifies on many small sessions. Example: tenant:flux had 0.03 tokens * 40k sessions -> $1.20 unexpected bump in preview.

priya: Oof. Dashboard impact is worse for low-volume tenants where cents matter. We should avoid ceil() at per-route; instead sum floats then round once at invoice line creation.

sam: Telemetry: add meter.billing.round_strategy tag and meter.billing.round_error_cents. Also emit meter.agg.fractional_tokens_sample with sampling 0.1% for deep dive.

billing-bot: job:invoice-preview-run completed at 1716004400. tenant:flux preview_delta_cents=120.

jorge: Short-term patch: change finalizer to banker's rounding on aggregate (round half to even) and re-run preview. Long-term: store token counts as fixed-point micros to avoid float drift.

nina: Agree. For rollout we should shadow the new rounding logic for 7 days and surface per-tenant delta in console. If delta > $2 or >0.5% hold out tenant.

priya: Console UX: add a "Rounding migration" card next to invoice preview showing old vs new line totals and a per-tenant impact estimate. Make it actionable so support can flag tenants into holdout list.

sam: I'll add metrics and alert: meter.recon.rounding_total_cents > 500 -> page billing@ and create incident. Also add a one-click revert kflag k.billing.rounding=v1.

oncall: Runbook: if automated alert triggers, run quick query to identify top 10 impacted tenants, and if any single tenant > $50, page billing and flip the kflag for affected shards. Revert command: `k8s set env deployment/metering BILLING_ROUNDING=v1 -n prod`

jorge: PR: I'll implement fixed-point internal representation and the banker's rounding fallback. Will open shadow PR today.

nina: Rollout plan: Day0 shadow (100% preview), Days1-7 recon + console surfacing, Day8 2% write canary for tenants with no flagged deltas, ramp if stable.

priya: Also ensure sampling logs include route_tag and quota_bucket so we can correlate rounding with quota ceilings.

sam: noted. will add meter.quota.bucket to sampled payloads.

billing-bot: nightly-reconciler queued at 1716004500.

nina: Thanks. Follow-ups: @jorge PR + shadow, @priya console card, @sam metrics + kflag, @oncall add runbook. We'll review first-night recon in this thread. :thumbsup:
